correctness.rationale: The affine lower bound follows for all n from rank at least two of any parity-check map: two independent syndromes cannot be corrected in a single common coordinate. For n=5, exhaustive monotone forbidden-set search checks every potential 17-subset after an XOR-translation normalization, visiting exactly 16,829,638 nodes and producing no witness. Two independent projection and literal-center checks certify all 4096 length-six target pairs with a 29-word code. Only \(K_2(6,1)\le29\) is claimed, not its exact optimum.
